page.layout: One printed page. One column of running text, with the page number at the top right and a catchword at the bottom right. No margin notes, no running head.

main_text.p: vel absolutionis a crimine petitione oblata, intra Synodum immani fastu, & iactantia ab fese absolutus, & reconciliatus, ante etiam Legatos Pontificios ab ipsa prima Actione praesidet, pro imperio omnia facit, aliis praecipit, & uno verbo, basilicas edictiones, atque imperiosas habet. Non dum Ignatij familiarium vincula, flagra, plagaeque, & omnis generis tormenta oblivioni tradita sunt: adhuc caprarium stabulum Ignatij tolerantiam clamat. Prometus, Numera, Terebinthus, atque Hiera insulae, & Metylene Ignatij duris exilijs celebrantur: molares excusi duo, vectibusque geminis pedes alligati, & angustum ergastulum cum summa rerum omnium inopia Photij tyrannidem, atque immanitatem praedicant: Blasij Chartophylacis lingua detruncata sonore iniustitiam vociferat: Pallium, Penula, Saccus, & reliqua Pontificalia indumenta a sancto viro per vim distracta, & lacera in terram impudenter proiecta vicem suam non leniter dolent: Minima haec sunt Photio, atrociora addenda. Condemnatus iniuste Ignatius, colaphis caeditur, miserè diuexatur, & cum frigus recrudesceret, unica tunicula induts discruciatur, & binis hebdomadis carcere conclusus, extrema prope fame con-

page.notes: The printed text ends at the foot with the catchword "con-". Two readings are doubtful. "induts" is printed as "indutus", with the final letters unclear; it is copied as "induts" in the transcription and should be checked. "miserè" is printed with the accent as shown. The page has show-through and edge marks on both sides, which were left out.
